description: SHAP analysis reveals C18 and site_id frequency drive 50%+ of model log-odds impact.

upstream.source_data: Stage 08 Champion XGBoost model + Stage 03 processed feature matrix.
upstream.inherited_features: 23 features scored across test set impressions.
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: SHAP provides unified, additive feature importance satisfying Efficiency, Symmetry, Dummy, and Additivity axioms.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: Gini importance is biased toward high-cardinality features. TreeSHAP computes exact Shapley values in polynomial time O(TLD^2) instead of exponential O(2^p).
mathematical_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(T \cdot L \cdot D^2) \text{ for TreeSHAP polynomial evaluation}

downstream.hand_off_contract: Proves C18_enc (+0.42 mean |SHAP|), site_id (+0.31), and app_id (+0.26) drive over 50% of the prediction log-odds impact.

adtech_role.system_component: Advertiser Transparency Portal & Algorithmic Audit Suite
adtech_role.business_impact: Provides explainable attribution reports to advertisers, explaining why specific high-value auctions were won or lost.
